delivery.question: How quickly are designs delivered?
delivery.answer: Standard ad sets in 2-3 business days, video ads in 3-5 business days.

pricing.question: How does pricing work?
pricing.answer: Project-based or monthly package options available. Priced by number of ads and platforms.

revisions.question: How many revisions do I get?
revisions.answer: 2 revision rounds are included per design. Unlimited revisions are offered for monthly package clients.
